body.name: Sparse canonical switching-certificate bound \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
body.construction:
Let \(m=|\mathcal A|\), \(L=|\mathrm{LIT}|\), \(n=|V|\), \(M=|\Omega|\), and \(q_M=\lceil\log_2(M+1)\rceil\).  Put
\[
 b_{\tau}=8(n+1)^2\left\lceil\log_2(n+L+M+2)\right\rceil
\]
and define
\[
 B_{\mathrm{sw}}
 =2\lfloor\log_2(M+1)\rfloor+1
  +M\bigl(m+L+q_M+n(1+L)+b_{\tau}\bigr).
\]
The first summand is the exact Elias-gamma framing length for the record count \(M\); the term \(Mq_M\) is the complete sparse branch-ownership contribution.  The bound is finite and may be exponential in the structural input.
